moat_against: No network effects or hard lock-in — Holcim/Firestone, Johns Manville and GAF contest every bid
Pricing power lags cost inflation (Q2 2026 price-cost negative; FY margin guide cut 50bp)
~30% of demand is cyclical new construction, currently down low-to-mid single digits
Petroleum-based inputs (MDI, asphalt, polymers) expose margins to commodity and freight shocks
Distribution-channel M&A turmoil has previously cost temporary share
moat_for: Leading share and specification position in commercial roofing — warranted systems create switching friction
~70% of CCM roofing revenue is non-discretionary re-roofing on the aging commercial building stock
Proven pricing power through inflation cycles (three broad 2026 price increases)
Vertical integration in insulation (Insulfoam/ThermaFoam, Bonded Logic) plus Carlisle Operating System margin gains; gross margin +~7pp in five years
moat_justification: Dominant specification position in North American commercial roofing with warranted systems and a ~70% recurring re-roofing base; ROIC proxy 17.5%/16.7%/24.7%/22.0% over 2022-2025 and gross margin up from 28.6% (2021) to 35.7% (2025), with ~25% ROIC guided for 2026 — but the high-ROIC history is only ~4 years on the pure-play mix, rivals are well-capitalized, and pricing lags cost inflation, so 7 not 8.
name: Carlisle Companies Incorporated
one_liner: High-quality building-envelope leader, moat 7/10 — at $333.86 the weighted IRR is 10.2% and it does not clear 15%; it clears 15% only at or below $200.22.
